title: Design System: Chia tiền · Hội nghị bàn tròn

display.purpose: The cat's single sentence above the table; one per screen.

amount.purpose: Transfer amount on each ticket; always tabular.

title.purpose: Session name in the top bar; item names at 700.

label.purpose: Uppercase muted section headings and table headers.

shadows.name: ticket-rest
shadows.purpose: Transfer tickets resting on the ground.

shadows.name: tab-lift
shadows.purpose: Selected tab in the bottom bar.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Bottom sheets and dialogs, over a #15171B80 backdrop.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Input focus halo with an ink border.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Fill and border changes on buttons, chips, the done checkbox.

motion.name: number-glide
motion.purpose: Every amount glides from its previous value after a change.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Paw, sheet rise and number glide all stop.

narrative.overview:
Settling the bill is a meeting at a round table, seen from directly above and chaired by a white-and-gold mèo thần tài. The table is the hero of the screen: a crimson lacquer disc with a gold rim, members sitting around it as saturated plastic stools, and white threads running from whoever pays to whoever receives, each carrying its amount. Everything else (the transfer tickets, the per-person table, the item list) is the minutes of that meeting, set quietly on cool aluminium.

The world is loud in exactly three places, the cat's one-line verdict at poster scale, the lacquer table, and the stool colours, and plain everywhere else. Surfaces are white cards on a pale grey ground, type is one family in heavy weights, and controls are large and thumb-sized because the screen is used one-handed at a restaurant table. Money is always set in tabular figures so columns line up and nobody argues about a đồng.
keyCharacteristics: One face (Be Vietnam Pro) from 500 to 900; black weight for the cat's line, heavy 800 for money.
A cool aluminium ground with white panels; crimson and gold live only on the table and the cat.
Each member owns one stool colour for the whole session, used on their seat, avatar, chip, dot and thread label.
Light only (`color-scheme: light`); no dark theme exists.
Motion is small and functional: a waving paw, a rising sheet, numbers that glide to their new value.

rules.name: The One Stool Rule
rules.body: A member's seat colour is their identity. Wherever that person appears (seat, avatar chip, colour dot, selected seat chip, thread label outline) it is the same colour, and no other element may borrow a seat colour for decoration.

rules.name: The Lacquer Is Furniture Rule
rules.body: Crimson and gold belong to the table and the cat. Interface chrome stays ink, white and aluminium; the primary action is black, not red.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every amount (tickets, thread labels, table cells, totals, previews, counts) is set with tabular figures. No proportional digits next to money.

rules.name: The Cat Speaks Once Rule
rules.body: Weight 900 at display size is the cat's voice only. It is one sentence, it lives above the table, and nothing else on the screen competes with it.

rules.name: The Paper On Metal Rule
rules.body: Only white panels cast shadows, and only soft ambient ones. Grey controls on the aluminium ground stay flat and change fill on hover instead.

dos: **Do** give every member one seat colour from the twelve-colour palette and use it in every place that person appears (The One Stool Rule).
**Do** set every amount in tabular figures at 800 weight.
**Do** keep the primary action ink black (#15171B fill, white label) and at least 48px tall.
**Do** keep crimson (#A8162B) and gold (#D9A928) on the table, the cat and the favicon only.
**Do** let only white panels cast the soft ticket shadow; grey controls change fill on hover.
**Do** stop the paw, the sheet rise and the number glide under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: **Don't** turn the table view into a list of cards or a ledger; the table seen from above stays the hero of the first viewport.
**Don't** use a seat colour for decoration, status, or any element not tied to that member.
**Don't** set anything but the cat's one sentence at 900 display size.
**Don't** add a second typeface; Be Vietnam Pro carries every role.
**Don't** make the primary button crimson or gold.
